summary: Preserve gate identity in isolated Pi stream tests

finding_disposition.test-enclosure-access-conflict: Resolved by the later selective authentic metadata read authorization and conforming launcher; no waiver or approval.
finding_disposition.test-2: Seven scenarios exercised with the precise live/deterministic distinctions below; genuine signed tool remains unavailable.

scenarios.name: Legacy fallback
scenarios.evidence: Real Pi CLI disabled and malformed monitoring preserved legacy busy limits (cli-fallback.log). Generated-extension version/option matrix, non-Pi and foreign-phase behavior passed deterministic executable-interface checks (focused.log). Unsupported-version coverage uses a version-reporting fixture, not a genuine older Pi.

scenarios.name: Foreground progress and request identity
scenarios.evidence: Real Pi1.2 SDK empty/substantive/background transport events passed; actual CLI loopback session proved request identity before first response content (sdk.log, cli.log).

scenarios.name: Tools, settlement, next request
scenarios.evidence: Actual Pi1.2 SDK tools and next request identity passed; CLI cleared stream evidence and persisted idle state on settlement (sdk.log, cli.log).

scenarios.name: Late, stale, retired, wrong identities
scenarios.evidence: Real writer public interface and generated-extension deterministic event fixtures reject invalid lifecycle events (focused.log); not described as vendor-live generation injection.

scenarios.name: Inspection only and continued progress
scenarios.evidence: Actual CLI plus generated extension, writer, watcher, private tmux and owned loopback SSE: inspection notification, same live pane, later revision advance, then settlement (cli.log).

scenarios.name: Publication lock races and ownership
scenarios.evidence: Six actual CLI close/progress/replace races across queue/recovery waits preserve absent marker (cli-races.log); deterministic twelve-case matrix also proves existing marker ownership (focused.log).

scenarios.name: Writer deadline and descendants
scenarios.evidence: Actual Pi1.2 SDK/generated extension deadline terminated injected stalled writer and output-holding descendant; this is explicit executable-boundary fault injection in a disposable toolkit fixture (sdk.log).

scenarios.name: Signed Pi executable
scenarios.evidence: command -v pi-signed found none on host; no installation or ordinary-Pi substitution.

reproduction: identity-red.log records failed marker equality for the prior env-i invocation shape; final sdk.log records marker equality for all three actual SDK subprocesses. sdk-setup-failure.log records initial /dev/null enclosure failure, corrected by a non-sticky private device directory.
isolation: launch.py -> unshare user/map-root/mount/private PID+proc/net/ipc -> readonly authentic source, assigned Git metadata, Pi package and toolchain -> chroot -> setpriv empty capability sets and no-new-privileges -> preflight -> bounded commands. Final launcher does not require sudo. All expected inherited markers preserved; no synthetic canonical Git metadata.
